I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message: "Thanks, Tobias, noted: expense reports are due this Friday (Oct 16). If you'd like a reminder in here before then, just let me know."

His message was a reminder rather than a request, so I didn't do anything else and haven't set up a reminder. I didn't read any channels, files or messages for this reply. I got Friday's date by counting from the message date, Wednesday Oct 14.
